# How to make an AI influencer or AI character people remember

**Turn an idea into an AI influencer or character with a locked look: premise, details, styling, a character sheet, then reuse in video.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-character-design`: ~$0.06–0.24 per sheet, ~$0.83–2.03 per 5 s clip (tested). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay.

<p><a href="../../varg-character-design/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_6baed9973414.webp" alt="A grid of eight memorable AI characters, from a grandma in leopard print to a sheep accountant in glasses, then the grandma speeds toward the camera on a red scooter." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`varg-character-design`](../../varg-character-design/README.md): define, detail, dress and lock the character in a sheet; picks the category recipe. The other 8 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-design --skill varg-character-beautiful-woman --skill varg-character-fitness --skill varg-character-cringe --skill varg-character-grandma --skill varg-character-big-guy --skill varg-character-cartoon --skill varg-character-absurd --skill character-passport
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make an AI fitness influencer for my workout app: a coach in her 40s with a signature outfit, a character sheet and three gym scenes."*

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `varg-character-design`: ~$0.06–0.24 per sheet, ~$0.83–2.03 per 5 s clip (tested).
- `varg-character-beautiful-woman`: ~$0.06–0.24 per image (tested).
- `varg-character-fitness`: ~$0.07 per sheet (Seedream 5 Pro, tested).
- `varg-character-cringe`: ~$0.07 per sheet (Seedream 5 Pro, tested).
- `varg-character-grandma`: ~$0.07 per sheet (Seedream 5 Pro, tested).
- `varg-character-big-guy`: ~$0.07 per sheet (Seedream 5 Pro, tested).

- `character-passport`: ~$0.05 per image (Nano Banana 2.1), ~$0.01 per voice take.

## FAQ

### How do I make an AI influencer that looks real, not plastic?

Write striking features one by one, real skin, and the styling and light of a real shoot. varg-character-beautiful-woman does this for fashion, swimwear and red-carpet looks; adults only, no nudity.

### Why do my swimwear or gym prompts get blocked?

The beautiful-woman and fitness recipes include catalog-style wording that gets swimwear, sports bras, leggings and shirtless athletes past false moderation blocks.

### Can I make a Pixar- or Simpsons-style version of me?

Yes. varg-character-cartoon describes the famous looks in words instead of IP names (the names get blocked and don't belong in ads) and can restyle an existing character or a selfie.

### How do I keep my AI influencer the same in every post?

Lock the look in a character sheet (varg-character-design) and reuse it in later images and videos on Nano Banana, GPT Image, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5 or Wan 3; character-passport pastes the same paragraph into every prompt.

### What makes an AI character memorable?

A premise, an archetype and a contrast, one signature detail and one loud colour. The cringe recipe adds a format: the same action in a new place every post.
